PublishedDocuments__Meta.Meta__Description: Which drawings of this project are published, and what the reader should do about the ones that are not. This is the FIRST and for an unpublished drawing the ONLY file a reader downloads: it carries enough of each document - number, name, order, paper, revision, status - to draw a correct sheet and a correct title block before a single element file is fetched. A drawing named here with a state of 'unpublished' gets its sheet and its title block and a grey mask where the drawing would be; no element file, no raster and no vector is requested for it, and nothing is computed on the device. The file is written LAST by a publish, after every document's own manifest has landed, so a half-finished publish is never visible.

PublishedDocuments__Publish.Publish__SchemaNote: A reader refuses a schema it does not know rather than half-reading it. Bumping this is a deliberate act: every published document in the bucket must be re-published, because a reader that understands schema 2 has no obligation to understand schema 1.
PublishedDocuments__Publish.Publish__ArchiveNote: Local only. A folder whose name starts with 00__ is skipped by the R2 sync, so no archive zip ever reaches the bucket or a client.
PublishedDocuments__Publish.Publish__MarksNote: Document__Marks on an unpublished row is the furniture for its sheet. It is here rather than in a document folder because an unpublished drawing HAS no folder - that absence is the whole grey-mask mechanism, and the reader must be able to draw a correct sheet without fetching anything.

PublishedDocuments__RasterTiers.RasterTiers__Description: The zoom ladder. Every published viewport raster exists at each screen tier and once at print. A tier is a PIXEL SIZE, not a codec: a WebP and a PNG of the same dimensions cost the same memory once decoded (width x height x 4 bytes), so the codec only changes the download. The reader opens a sheet on Tier01, and steps up a tier when the sheet's zoom means a tier's pixels would be smaller than the screen's. It never holds two tiers of the same viewport: the new one replaces the old.
PublishedDocuments__RasterTiers.RasterTiers__PaperMmNote: PixelsPerMm is pixels per PAPER millimetre at the size the viewport frame occupies on the sheet, exactly as LayoutEditor__Raster__Config means it. MaxPixels caps the longest side.

RasterTiers__Tiers.Tier__Note: What a sheet opens on. A sheet fitted to a phone in portrait is about 0.65 CSS px per paper mm; at a device pixel ratio of 3 that is 2 device px per mm, so this tier is already at native resolution when the sheet is fitted.
152 dpi at paper size. Zoomed in far enough to read a dimension string. Matches the authoring side's Low raster level.

305 dpi at paper size - print quality on screen, and the top tier a reader ever loads. Matches the authoring side's Medium raster level, which is what the viewer decodes TODAY for a sheet that is merely fitted to the screen.

508 dpi at paper size, PNG, and NEVER loaded to look at. Downloaded only when the reader asks for the PDF, and dropped as soon as the PDF is built. PNG because jsPDF drops the alpha of raw RGBA and because print is the one place lossless earns its bytes.

PublishedDocuments__RasterTiers.RasterTiers__DeviceNote: A device that is struggling is given a SMALLER TIER, never a different codec. If a tier's decode fails or the device reports little memory, the reader stays on the tier below and says so in the dock rather than retrying the tier that failed.

PublishedDocuments__Documents.Document__Note: An introduction sheet: pictures and text, no model viewport. Nothing was rendered for it - the pictures were already published as sheet images.
Revision A of this document is in 00__Archive__Revisions as a zip. Only Revision B is on R2.
Drawn, not published. The reader draws the A2 sheet and the title block from THIS entry, masks the drawing area grey and says so. It requests nothing else.
PublishedDocuments__Documents.Document__MarksNote: The furniture for a drawing that is NOT published. Laying out a title block needs no model and no render, so the publisher writes it for every row of the register - which is what lets an unpublished sheet still show its own number, title and revision behind the grey mask instead of being a blank page.

PublishedDocuments__Superseded.Superseded__Description: Reserved. Today only the latest revision of a document is on R2 and past revisions live in the local archive zips. When past revisions are wanted on R2 they are named here, each with its own folder, and the reader offers them behind the revision letter in the title block. Nothing reads this yet.
